ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(ISPICKVAL(Type , 'Deal Termination'),
OR(ISPICKVAL(ReasonsForTermination__c , ''),
ISBLANK( Reasons_for_Termination__c ), ISBLANK( End_Date__c ) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If Type is Deal Termination, Reasons for Termination, Termination Date and Further Justification is mandatory.
